blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte made his first in-person appearance before the International Criminal Court (ICC) on Wednesday, more than a year after he was arrested in Manila and surrendered to the tribunal’s custody in The Hague. Duterte appeared before Trial Chamber III during the third status conference in his case, where he faces three counts of crimes against humanity linked to his administration’s war on drugs. His last appearance before the judges was on March 14, 2025, when he joined the proceedings via videoconference.
